name: comparator-offset-tran
description: Total input-referred offset of the whole comparator (preamp + StrongARM latch + SR latch) by transient Monte Carlo over the full 45-point PVT grid, with the same-draw preamp-only offset measured in the same run so the decision-stage (latch) contribution is quantified, plus a derived (not simulated) hand budget for the ppolyf_u_1k load-pair mismatch this PDK does not model.
claim: REFERENCE against the ratified Offset 3-sigma row (README.md#target-specification-ratified-via-dr-0002; <= 15 mV target, <= 8 mV stretch): adds the two contributors the DC-sweep bench sim/comparator-offset-mc/ cannot see (latch offset, measured; load-resistor mismatch, derived by hand). It is additive -- the DC bench stays as the preamp-only number -- and it does not alter any ratified bound; a miss, if any, is recorded as a miss. Scope: 5 process corners (tt, ss, ff, fs, sf) x 3 temperatures (-40/27/125 C) x 3 supplies (2.97/3.30/3.63 V) = 45 PVT points, N = 200 draws each (9,000 transients); extends the nine-point tt/ss/ff nominal-supply reference record, which stays as committed.
